h1: TonLiw Hotel — a fresh, clean boutique in a quiet garden at Si Bun Rueang
intro: If you want a stay in Si Bun Rueang district with genuinely fresh, clean rooms and real peace and quiet, TonLiw Hotel is the name people are starting to mention as a little place that's looked after far better than its price suggests · It's a boutique hotel set back from the main road down a quiet lane, wrapped in a leafy garden, with a private balcony on every room and an owner who runs it personally and sweats the details · Choices range from Deluxe rooms to 2-3 bedroom garden villas for families · Rooms start from approx. ฿890/night — a tidy choice for anyone who values calm and quality over a city-centre address.

A guest-room balcony looking out over TonLiw Hotel's leafy garden
The garden and common areas of TonLiw Hotel in Si Bun Rueang

body.html: TonLiw Hotel sits at 5/2 Moo 4, Ban Suan Sawan, Han Na Ngam sub-district, Si Bun Rueang, Nong Bua Lamphu — an out-of-town stay set back from the main road down a quiet lane, ringed by garden · It's a small, newly opened boutique that locals and road-trippers have started passing along to each other as a quiet place that's cared for beyond its price · Handy for anyone driving the Udon-Loei route or running errands around Si Bun Rueang who just wants a comfortable night's sleep.

What guests mention most is how fresh, clean and tastefully simple the rooms are · Rooms run from around 32 sqm upward and every single one has a private balcony looking onto the garden · Many reviews say the beds and bedding are surprisingly good for a small upcountry hotel · Rooms come with air-con, a flat-screen TV, a sensibly priced mini-bar and free Wi-Fi throughout · Choices span from a Deluxe double up to 2-3 bedroom garden villas for families or groups of friends.
"Brand-new, spotless room, bed as comfortable as a big hotel, the owner is lovely and takes care of everything, and the lane is so quiet you sleep beautifully."

Another point that comes up again and again is the owner, who runs the place personally — attentive, warm, and speaks excellent English · Several guests say it feels more like staying at a friend's home than checking into a hotel · The property has a leafy garden, a wide shared terrace, a lounge, a 24-hour front desk and a laundry service for a small fee · And for anyone driving, the key detail is free on-site parking, secure and covered by CCTV — no need to worry about the car.

Now the honest part — this is an out-of-town location, not central Nong Bua Lamphu · If your plan is to explore the main town or its shops, you'll be driving a fair bit, so it suits guests with their own car · It also has no swimming pool and no buffet breakfast (there's a separate set-menu breakfast for around ฿180) · And because it's a small property with few rooms, it fills up fast on long weekends — book ahead.

In short, TonLiw Hotel is ideal for anyone wanting a fresh, clean, quiet stay close to nature in Si Bun Rueang, whether as a couple or a family · Its overall score of around 9.8 from real reviews mirrors exactly what people describe — good rooms, an owner who genuinely cares, and a calm setting · The trade-off is the out-of-town location and the limited big-hotel facilities · But if you've got a car and you value quiet plus quality rooms, this delivers a value-for-money feeling that's hard to find in the province.

faqTitle: FAQ — TonLiw Hotel, Si Bun Rueang

faq.q: Where is TonLiw Hotel in Nong Bua Lamphu?
faq.a: It's at 5/2 Moo 4, Ban Suan Sawan, Han Na Ngam, Si Bun Rueang, Nong Bua Lamphu · an out-of-town stay set back from the main road down a quiet lane · It's about a 30-minute drive from Nong Bua Lamphu town and roughly an hour from Udon Thani, so it suits guests with their own car.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. ฿890/night for a Deluxe Standard · There's a Deluxe Premier around ฿990, a Family Room around ฿1,190, and 2-3 bedroom garden villas around ฿1,390-2,390 · Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms like — do they have balconies?
faq.a: The strong point is that rooms are fresh, clean and tastefully simple, and every room has a private garden-facing balcony · Rooms are 32 sqm and up, with good-quality beds and bedding that many reviews say sleep better than the price suggests.

faq.q: Is there parking and a swimming pool?
faq.a: There's free on-site parking, secure and covered by CCTV — ideal if you're driving · However, there's no swimming pool here · The draw instead is the leafy garden and each room's private balcony.
There's no buffet breakfast here, but a set-menu breakfast for around ฿180 that you can arrange with the owner in advance · Alternatively, it's easy to grab a bite in Si Bun Rueang town.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for couples and families with a car who want a fresh, clean, quiet stay close to nature in Si Bun Rueang · The 2-3 bedroom garden villas suit larger groups · It's less suited to those without a car or who want a city-centre stay with a pool.
